analysis.executive_summary: Iberia Outfitters is an Outdoor apparel and accessories opportunity at Demo / Qualification stage. The automation recommends conditional pursue: price only serviceable scope and require leadership review. Serviceable volume is 765,912 parcels annually (2,098 daily), not the full raw opportunity. Key exclusions include Portugal - Mainland, France, Locker delivery requested for some rural customers.

scenarios.label: Aggressive
scenarios.rationale: Use only if Amazon needs a sharp entry price and leadership accepts minimum-margin risk.
scenarios.trade_offs: Maximizes price competitiveness but leaves little room for concessions. Includes SOD premium controls.
scenarios.negotiation_strategy: Use as a floor only after the customer confirms all unsupported scope is removed or split.

scenarios.label: Balanced
scenarios.rationale: Recommended anchor because it meets the finance target while preserving room to negotiate.
scenarios.trade_offs: Balances competitiveness with the 21% target margin and keeps negotiation room. Includes SOD premium controls.
scenarios.negotiation_strategy: Lead with this option and frame it around service reliability, peak readiness, and transparent pricing.

scenarios.label: Conservative
scenarios.rationale: Use when the customer values resilience, premium controls, and implementation certainty over lowest price.
scenarios.trade_offs: Protects margin and execution risk, but may weaken price-score competitiveness. Includes SOD premium controls.
scenarios.negotiation_strategy: Use if Iberia Outfitters prioritizes service certainty and scope discipline over the lowest possible rate.

commercial_strategy.positioning: Lead with serviceable Spain scope, campaign-peak readiness, tracking reliability, and strict carve-outs for unsupported geography, returns, oversize parcels, and PUDO fallback.
